description: This Scala source file defines the DataSourceRegistration class, which provides functions for registering user-defined data sources within Apache Spark's SQL module. It includes methods for registering Python data sources and checking for existing data sources, handling errors related to data source registration.

classes.name: DataSourceRegistration
classes.description: A class providing methods to register user-defined data sources, including Python data sources, and to check for existing data sources within Spark SQL.

methods.name: registerPython
methods.description: Registers a new Python data source with the given name and configuration, logging details and checking for existing data sources before registration.

methods.name: checkDataSourceExists
methods.description: Checks if a data source with the specified name already exists, throwing an error if a non-user-defined data source with the same name is found.
